text:
Sam Chen: FYI — after the kernel-selection tweak at 08:12 we've got a noticeable p95/p99 regression on Mixtral MoE router paths. p95 up ~60ms on 1k tok requests.
Maya Patel: ugh. saw alerts too. any obvious hotspot from flamegraphs? :thinking_face:
Alex Ortiz: quick profiler dump shows router dispatch + softmax kernel time increased. but biggest delta is KV cache eviction churn.
Li Wang: i ran a short trace, looks like head/kv dim mismatch on the new kernel path is making the router reserialize some KV pages -> eviction thrash.
Sam Chen: here's a short summary from the perf run:
```
workload: mixtral-8e(64ex)x64heads, seq=1024
baseline: p95=120ms p99=210ms
post-change: p95=180ms p99=320ms
flame (cpu): router_dispatch 47%, kv_cache_eviction 29%, softmax_kernel 13%, other 11%
memory: kv cache churn +18% writebacks/min
```
Maya Patel: interesting. did the kernel selector pick a different GEMM layout for the head-dim/kv-dim combo?
Alex Ortiz: yes — selector chose the optimized fp16-fused-softmax path but the code assumes contiguous kv layout, our MoE hotset uses a sharded kv packing that now triggers slower path.
Nate (ops-bot): @channel deploy 08:12 kernel-selector rollout succeeded on mixtral-pool-2 (image: runtime:v3.14.0) :white_check_mark:
Sam Chen: that rollout is the cause. we need rollback or mitigation fast. options: rollback kernel, force kernel hint for mixtral-MoE, or tune router top-k to reduce expert churn.
Li Wang: quick mitigation idea: cap per-request top_k to 2 for hot traffic and enable conservative softfill. reduces expert fanout and KV pressure.
Maya Patel: can we A/B target a small percentage to verify?
Alex Ortiz: yes. config snippet to try (router policy override):
```json
{
  "model": "mixtral-8e-64h",
  "router": {
    "top_k": 2,
    "softfill": "conservative",
    "max_expert_parallelism": 4,
    "kv_prefetch": "on-demand"
  }
}
```
Sam Chen: also try forcing kernel hint: KERNEL_HINT=legacy-gemm for mixtral MoE models until we fix selector heuristics. That avoids the fused-softmax path.
Maya Patel: ran a canary with top_k=2 on 5% traffic — p95 back to ~130ms, kv eviction down 40%. promising.
Alex Ortiz: good. we should gather more traces but plan rollback window if canary doesn't hold.
Li Wang: long term: adjust kernel selector heuristic to consider (head_dim, kv_layout, expert_shard) tuple. current feature set only considers head_dim+seq_len which is too coarse.
Sam Chen: Agreed. I'll open an action ticket for selector: include kv_layout bitflag + add test matrix for Mixtral MoE sharded KV.
Maya Patel: also add an eviction metric to our model-level SLO dashboard (kv_evictions/min) so this is visible during rollouts.
Alex Ortiz: note: RoPE scaling interacts here — during long sequences we see more cache hits but also different kernel tiling. we should add a perf test with rope_scale=0.5/1.0/2.0.
Sam Chen: can someone prepare a perf job matrix? include head_dim variants (32/64/128), kv layout packed/sharded, rope_scale variants, and top_k in {1,2,4,8}.
Li Wang: I'll put up a job set — using mixtral-sim runner. estimate ~6 hours for the full sweep.
ate (ops-bot): perf job scheduled: mixtral-moerun-sweep-2955554321-01 — results expected +6h
Maya Patel: next steps: 1) keep the canary (top_k=2) at 5% and monitor kv_eviction and latency 2) rollback kernel-selector if canary regresses 3) action item for selector heuristic + perf matrix 4) add kv_eviction metric to dashboard
Sam Chen: i'll coordinate rollback window at 12:00 UTC if canary isn't stable. tagging @oncall in case we need to flip.
Alex Ortiz: one more note — when we force legacy-gemm kernel we see slightly higher overall GPU utilization but lower tail because less thrash. tradeoff seems worth it for stable SLO.
Maya Patel: thanks all. will update runbook with the transient top_k mitigation. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused on mixtral-pool-2 due to increased p99 latency — action required.
Sam Chen: logging action items in the ticket now (selector-heuristic, dashboard, perf jobs, canary watch).
